maddeler.e:
أتحالف (form VI)
# أَتَحَالَفُ (ʔataḥālafu) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.la.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
# أَتَحَالَفَ (ʔataḥālafa) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.la.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
# أَتَحَالَفْ (ʔataḥālaf) /ʔa.ta.ħaː.laf/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَحَالَفَ (taḥālafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
